profile.headline: Application Support | Software Engineer | Software Developer : Fast Learning, Independent, and Reliable Team Player
profile.summary:
Tiffany is passionate about her career.  When she's on the job, she's committed. She is fun, creative and a solid team player. She takes pride in being reliable and responsible, putting her whole heart into her work, and she desires to never fall behind.
Starting out as a Front-end ASP/Web Programmer years ago for a company called Ellipse, she honed her web skills and handled high profile clients. 
After transitioning to a new career field at nThrive, a healthcare revenue management company, Tiffany explored the C# language on the Claim Management application to the fundamental knowledge of American National Standards Institute ANSI for health care 837 835  electronic transmitting. Her Data Management team supported 2 important products of nThrive: Claim Management and Contract Manager.  Her role was to monitor, process and troubleshoot any data issue while importing.  She was a Software Engineer of nThrive almost 6.5 years.

positions.title: ServiceNow Platform Software Developer
positions.description:
- Agile Project Management for production teams. 
- Set up project/repository and support the Jira/Confluence 
- Served as system administer for Jira application
- Helpdesk support for Agile work management
- Developing, and troubleshooting ServiceNow applications
-Configurate the ServiceNow's ITSM service catalog

positions.title: Application Production Support
positions.description:
- Monitoring activities/process of production applications for Corporate and Investment Banking line of business. 
- Handle day to day issues including daily health checks of application, working closely with End User, Development staff and Instructure team to prioritize and resolved ticket and provide work around.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
- Debugging and defect resolution for Loan Origination System
- Testing and validating the Argo's application logics meets specifications
- Coding in middle-tier application's SOAP requests and returning functional responses to front-end interfaces. 
- Modifying and developing Argo’s Front End Online Account Opening website with HTML, CSS,JavaScript and C#. Rebuilt our front end UI in React JS utilized ES6 syntax.
- Work management and code control tool using JIRA, Source Tree and GIT.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Processing claim/report files for Contract Manager Product: monitor job fails, troubleshoot for root cause and update production
- Processing Claims from SFTP to claim in Claim Management Product:GlobalScape rules, set up auto import configuration, monitoring XClaim Application Service in task servers, modify system configuration to process claim import and export.
- Claim Management: Created form locator fix/bridge routine or the method/function in C# in Microsoft Visual Studio 2015 to manipulate the claims
- Pull claim related report in Primary and Archive database using SQL query, store procedure in MS SQL Studio
- In Microsoft SQL Server 2008, run Store Procedure, re-run a job fail,view and update data
- Decipher the American National Standards Institute (ANSI) 837 claim file for Professional and

positions.title: ASP Programmer, Front-End Web Developer
positions.description:
-	Imaged slicing in Photoshop CS4, editing and enhancing images/logos using graphic design tools: Photoshop CS3 and higher, Illustrator, Flash and Bridge
-	Coded web pages in Dreamweaver editor utilizing HTML language 
-	Enriched dynamic data driven webpages in classic ASP
-	Embedded external and internal Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) inside the webpages
-	Designed interactive sites with JavaScript, Ajax, JQuery effects on webpage tree menu, display text/image, pop-up message boxes, interact forms, survey, email, etc..
-	Form validated online input with JavaScript
-	Attractive display photo gallery using Lightbox and Thickbox technique
-	Programmed multiple logins, accounts, and access levels, using HTTP requests, cookies, and session variables
-	Customized Content Management System CMS web portals in that allowed users to self-manage webpage’s contents
-	Customized website toolbox application in ASP.Net platform using C#
-	Utilized and compliant to Search Engine Optimization SEO Meta tags to help establish a professional, desirable and highly functional website
-	Provided technical supports for major Multi Family Management Companies such as Lynd, Bell Partner
